acquisition_note: Direct downloads of the official ZIP/XLSX returned HTTP 403 in this environment. The two event schema files were retrieved from a public mirror of the national 1.01 schema. Their structure agrees with the official API manual and the event simple types already bundled; the bytes were not compared against a freshly downloaded government archive.
dependency_note: Uses each environment existing tiposComplexos_v1.01.xsd, tiposSimples_v1.01.xsd and xmldsig-core-schema.xsd without modifications.
